later accepted decisions that intentionally supersede older requirements

sections.start_locator: # Project Index - Treejar AI Sales Bot
# **Методика оценки диалогов и чек-лист / Dialogue Evaluation Method and Checklist**
"""Compact runtime policy derived from the client dialogue rules."""

precedence.rationale: The canonical runtime is Noor at https://noor.starec.ai; application-native webhook evidence and provider-originated ingress are distinct evidence tiers.
supersedes: Any claim that direct webhook injection alone proves provider-to-provider WhatsApp ingress

checks: One inbound persisted and one outbound audited
Separate EN/AR provider correlation or explicit non-pass
oracle.failure_condition: Any identity mismatch, duplicate/orphaned processing, or unproven provider ingress claimed as PASS

precedence.rationale: New and returning behavior follows the current CRM identity and bounded-context implementation.

checks: New identity creates only expected synthetic records
Returning identity receives relevant bounded context
No new-customer opener for returning fixture
oracle.failure_condition: Wrong customer status, missing expected synthetic record, duplicate record, or leaked/unbounded context

precedence.rationale: The current customer-facing identity is Noor; the old Siyyad wording is retained only as historical provenance.

checks: First EN and AR reply language and identity
Unknown-name gate has no product/quote side effect
oracle.failure_condition: Wrong identity or locale, repeated name question, lost prior request, or name-gate side effect

precedence.rationale: Voice acceptance requires persisted transcript, locale response, and audit correlation, not merely provider receipt.

oracle.failure_condition: Skipped voice batch, missing transcript/audit, or wrong-language answer

precedence.rationale: Treejar Catalog API owns customer-facing catalog fields; Zoho Inventory is operational confirmation and quotation/SaleOrder state.
supersedes: Zoho Inventory as primary customer-facing catalog

checks: Named options match catalog identity, description, category, image, and price
Delivery statements use applicable verified policy
Zoho rate never replaces catalog price
oracle.failure_condition: Any customer catalog fact differs from the bound catalog snapshot or uses a superseded primary source

precedence.rationale: Consultative selling and values apply only where evidence and capability policy authorize the claim.
supersedes: Unconditional discount, payment, warranty, delivery, stock, or sample wording in older values

checks: At most one bounded useful clarification after value
oracle.failure_condition: Unhelpful interrogation, invented benefit/discount, false match, fake SKU, or premature handoff

precedence.rationale: tj-r1f3 is closed with exact deployed runtime identity, healthy readback, and a separately quota-bound 5/5 provider retest; PASS still requires binding that fresh evidence into the current acceptance run.
supersedes: Promise to check later when an in-turn tool is required

checks: Exact tool/FAQ/manager evidence correlates to each claim
oracle.failure_condition: Any unsupported commercial fact, future-check promise, specific-product trial promise, or policy override

precedence.rationale: Order confirmation, delivery, and payment state come from the current operational status path.

checks: Returned confirmation, delivery, and payment state matches readback
oracle.failure_condition: Guessed, stale, mismatched, or unverified order status

precedence.rationale: FU1/FU2/FU3 and feedback follow delivered policy; payment reminders and unresolved templates remain disabled/non-pass until separately approved.
supersedes: Unconditional reminder and dozhim wording in original requirements

checks: Decision bound to current quotation prompt
oracle.failure_condition: Stale decision, wrong locale, immediate FU3 rejection, duplicate feedback, or unauthorized lifecycle send

open_known_risks: client-owned payment-reminder template and timing approval

precedence.rationale: Catalog price is customer-facing truth; delivery, discounts, markups, tax, and segment pricing require approved inputs.

oracle.failure_condition: Wrong price/quantity/total, unapproved adjustment, or missing personalization provenance

open_known_risks: client-owned personalized pricing rules when absent

precedence.rationale: Current mapping owns source, original/latest UTM, segment, address, and overwrite behavior.

checks: Synthetic CRM fields equal input fixture
Failure path preserves customer response and emits operation signal
oracle.failure_condition: Missing/wrong field, unsafe overwrite, duplicate record, secret leak, or dropped inbound batch

precedence.rationale: The original New Deal, In Progress, Negotiation, Paid acceptance sequence remains explicit and must be mapped to current CRM values.

checks: Authorized synthetic deal starts at mapped New Deal
Each authorized transition produces expected mapped stage
oracle.failure_condition: Missing, skipped, duplicated, or incorrectly mapped stage transition

open_known_risks: exact client CRM pipeline mapping must be bound

precedence.rationale: Current dialogue frames, OrderState, and customer memory own fact attachment and stale-state boundaries.

checks: Compact answers attach to expected frame
oracle.failure_condition: Lost, invented, conflicted, wrongly attached, or stale fact/state

precedence.rationale: Quotation requires exact SKU, quantity, explicit customer data, valid catalog price, and operational item confirmation.
supersedes: Manager approval as a replacement for a successfully generated customer quotation
Zoho rate fallback for missing catalog price

checks: Variant parser resolves intended SKU and quantity
oracle.failure_condition: Fake/wrong item or quantity, invented data, premature escalation or mutation, fail-open quote, or inconsistent document/state

precedence.rationale: Only current hard triggers hand off; ordinary discovery, detail capture, and supported low-risk service answers stay with Noor.
supersedes: Broad verified-policy handoff for ordinary requests

checks: Hard trigger creates one durable escalation and alert
oracle.failure_condition: Silence, premature/duplicate handoff, incomplete context, invented manager fact, or unresolved synthetic escalation

precedence.rationale: Admin evidence is separately authorized and actions must be observable rather than silently assumed.

checks: Authorized manager role reaches each required surface
Actions report persisted result or explicit disabled/error state
oracle.failure_condition: Unauthorized access, missing required surface, silent action, or hidden 5xx

precedence.rationale: The current 15-rule four-block weighted method with n_a supersedes a flat denominator.
supersedes: Flat 0-30 sum that penalizes unreached dialogue stages

oracle.failure_condition: Wrong rule set/weights/denominator or missing evidence-backed narrative

precedence.rationale: Manager assessment applies only after escalation resolution or CRM close and must cite transcript evidence.

oracle.failure_condition: Premature assessment, unsupported qualitative score, or incorrect quantitative metric

precedence.rationale: Required bot, manager, conversion, refusal, and operational reports must be observable and bounded by cost controls.

checks: Each required report opens or produces explicit disabled state
oracle.failure_condition: Missing report, silent action, irreproducible metric, or uncontrolled spend

precedence.rationale: Alternatives and complements are useful only when catalog-backed and tied to the customer's need/context.

oracle.failure_condition: Off-catalog exact-match claim, irrelevant option, or unsupported personalization

precedence.rationale: Referral launch remains blocked until exact client business rules and synthetic reward constraints are approved or explicitly excluded.

checks: Approved rules and reward constraints exist
oracle.failure_condition: Missing client rules, real reward/target, or unresolved side effect

evidence_required: client-approved implementation evidence or explicit client exclusion

precedence.rationale: Security acceptance combines transport/admin controls, least privilege, data minimization, and policy isolation.

oracle.failure_condition: Unauthorized access, secret/PII exposure, policy override, or stale deleted knowledge leak

precedence.rationale: The original less-than-10-second visible-response target remains a hard criterion; later internal p50/p95 targets do not replace it.
supersedes: Treating the tj-15m p50/p95 optimization target as acceptance of the original <10s contract

checks: First-visible, final-text, media, and scenario timestamps
External-model and local delivery latency separated
oracle.failure_condition: Any contractual measurement at or above 10 seconds, missing timing boundary, or hidden timeout

precedence.rationale: The 99% uptime target requires a declared authoritative window; point-in-time health is not uptime proof.

checks: Authoritative monitor and time window bound
oracle.failure_condition: Computed uptime below 99%, missing authoritative window, or unsupported extrapolation

open_known_risks: client acceptance window and monitor source must be confirmed

precedence.rationale: The 100+ concurrent-dialogue target requires a separately authorized synthetic load block and cannot be inferred from unit tests.

oracle.failure_condition: Concurrency below target, unsafe target set, capacity failure, or missing recovery evidence

precedence.rationale: Daily backups and 30-day retention require restore/integrity evidence; policy configuration alone is insufficient.

oracle.failure_condition: Missing day, retention below 30 days, failed/unproven restore, or missing ownership

open_known_risks: protected restore metadata and authorization required

precedence.rationale: Original 95% Inventory/API and 90% photo/description thresholds remain explicit while Treejar Catalog API owns customer-facing price.

oracle.failure_condition: Coverage below 95% or 90%, wrong denominator, non-catalog customer price, or wrong segment price

open_known_risks: exact co-temporal catalog and Inventory snapshots require readback approval

precedence.rationale: The top-three offer-generation target remains at most two seconds with an explicit timing boundary.

checks: Exactly top three result set recorded
Offer-generation timing boundary at or below two seconds
oracle.failure_condition: Timing above two seconds, wrong result count, or unbound query/catalog identity

precedence.rationale: Media follows final named products and the main text, with suppression after terminal product/quote/handoff states.

oracle.failure_condition: Mismatched/repeated/early media, redundant caption, raw URL, or malformed WhatsApp formatting

precedence.rationale: tj-r1f3 is closed with exact deployed runtime identity, healthy readback, and a separately quota-bound 5/5 provider retest; PASS still requires binding that fresh evidence into the current acceptance run.
supersedes: Treating tj-j13d closure or b8de75c deployment as sufficient grounding acceptance

checks: Fresh deployed release and exact model/service readback
oracle.failure_condition: Dependency is not freshly closed/proven, target release is assumed, provider smoke is not 5/5, or an in-scope P0/P1 remains
